capabilities.title: No Technical Skills Required
capabilities.subtitle: AI does the analysis — you make the decisions

analysis.title: Don't know indicators? No problem
analysis.desc: MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands — you don't need to learn any of that. The system automatically analyzes price action, money flow, and market sentiment from multiple angles. You just read the conclusions.

consensus.title: Multiple AI models, not just one
consensus.desc: Instead of one model guessing, multiple AIs analyze independently and then combine their views. It's like asking several analysts at once — agreement and disagreement are both valuable signals.

practice.title: Track record speaks for itself
practice.desc: Every analysis is recorded. After some time, you can look back at accuracy and win rates — all tracked by the system. No empty promises, just historical data.

modes.title: Pick Your Rhythm
modes.subtitle: Not sure which to choose? If you just want a daily overview, "Trend" is all you need

scalping.name: Scalping
scalping.desc: For those who can watch the screen. The system tracks minute-by-minute changes to spot quick entry and exit opportunities.

intraday.name: Intraday
intraday.desc: For those who check in a few times a day. The system reads the day's rhythm and tells you whether the day leans bullish or bearish.

trend.name: Trend
trend.desc: For those who don't have time to watch charts. The system reads the big picture — uptrend, downtrend, or sideways — check it once every few days.

product.title: What You Get After Signing Up
product.subtitle: Three main features, ready to use right away

dashboard.title: See everything at a glance
dashboard.desc: What's happening with the assets you follow? Any opportunities? High risk? Open the dashboard and see the latest signals for all your tracked assets in one view. No need to search everywhere.

consensus.title: AI analyzes, you read the results
consensus.desc: Pick an asset, tap analyze, and the system gets to work — multiple AIs examine the market simultaneously, then tell you the likely direction and key price levels. If they disagree, you'll know that too.

playbook.title: See what the big players might be thinking
playbook.desc: Flip the perspective: if you had billions to move, what would you do with this asset right now? The system reasons from that angle, helping you think one step ahead before making decisions.

data.title: Where the Data Comes From
data.desc: Analysis isn't guesswork. The system collects data 24/7 from multiple channels — exchange quotes, blockchain fund flows, derivatives markets, global economic data — ensuring every analysis is evidence-based.
